title: IRC adapter: a local IRC server (ircd) over mimid-agent's JMAP Chat
description: Lets any IRC client (irssi, WeeChat, HexChat, Adium's IRC) use MIMI rooms. A loopback-only IRC server: a MIMI room is a channel, a 1:1 Chat a query, users are nicks derived from user URIs (collisions need a rule), IRCv3 (message-tags, server-time, msgid, echo-message, chathistory) where it helps. All adapters sit on mimid-agent's local JMAP Chat endpoint (decision mimid-1wgh.38): the agent does MLS and holds keys; the adapter translates plaintext JMAP Chat to the client's protocol on the user's own machine, loopback only, with the agent's bearer token. Never serve plaintext beyond the local machine (AGENTS.md). Map: Chat <-> room/channel/MUC, Message <-> message, ChatContact <-> nick/JID/URI, attachments via the agent's blob routes, presence only if JMAP Chat has it. Status: idea, not scheduled.
